name: ai-meeting-draw
description: Read, create and edit open-source AI Meeting Draw diagram boards, browse versions and comment.
long_description: MCP server for a locally hosted AI Meeting Draw instance. Agents can list and read boards, create and update diagrams, browse versions and post comments.

base_url.title: AI Meeting Draw URL
base_url.description: Origin of the AI Meeting Draw instance (your own when self-hosting).

agent_name.title: Agent name
agent_name.description: Display name on the agent's comments and version snapshots.

ai_provider.title: AI provider (optional)
ai_provider.description: Bring-your-own-key provider for generate_diagram: claude, openai, gemini, openrouter or custom. Leave empty to use the instance's free pool.

ai_key.title: AI provider key (optional)
ai_key.description: Sent only to the AI Meeting Draw instance per call; never stored.
